subject: Next steps & MAP: Novaterra pilot milestones and responsibilities
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Gomez <lydia@novaterra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps & MAP: Novaterra pilot milestones and responsibilities

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for a productive discovery session this morning. I captured the key outcomes and sketched a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the 6-week pilot. Attached: Novaterra_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (master milestones).

High-level recap:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Novaterra’s order-routing use case (latency < 350ms P90, maintain accuracy within 2% of baseline).
- Pilot scope: 3 endpoints (order-normalization, fraud-score reranker, enrichment) + integration runbook.
- Success criteria: latency/accuracy targets, sample throughput (100 req/s sustained), and a sign-off checkpoint for go-live readiness.

Immediate next steps (proposed owners & dates in the MAP):
1) Integration kickoff (Novaterra devs + Redwood SE) — owner: Raj Patel — target: 2027-02-25
2) Legal/Procurement review of SOW — owner: Novaterra Legal — target: 2027-03-03
3) Performance validation (bench + shadow traffic) — owner: Redwood SE (Camila) — target: 2027-03-10
4) Exec sign-off & procurement signature — owner: Lydia/Novaterra — target: 2027-03-15

Dependencies called out in the MAP: access to staging APIs, an NDA addendum for sample data retention, and a short performance SLA for the pilot period.

Could you please confirm: (a) the listed owners on your side, (b) the proposed go-live target (we suggested 2027-03-21), and (c) whether Legal needs any additional doc templates? If you’re good with the MAP, we’ll move to a revised SOW and a procurement-ready packet.

Thanks —
Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0191

Attachment: Novaterra_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (milestones + owner columns)
From: Lydia Gomez <lydia@novaterra.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@novaterra.com>, Novaterra Legal <legal@novaterra.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Next steps & MAP: Novaterra pilot milestones and responsibilities

Thanks Camila — helpful recap and thanks for pulling the MAP together. Quick notes from our side: we like the timeline but need two adjustments before we can sign off on owners/dates.

1) Legal review window — our legal team needs until 2027-03-07 (they have a board packet next week). Please plan on that moving the SOW signoff target to 2027-03-09.
2) Integration dependency — Raj flagged that our staging environment will only be available after a config freeze on 2027-02-26 (so integration kickoff moves to 2027-02-28).

Also attaching a list of required security artifacts that Legal wants during review: SOC 2 summary, data retention policy, and a PCI scoping note. Can Redwood provide an abbreviated package? If you can put those into the procurement packet we’ll be able to accelerate review.

We’re enthusiastic about the pilot and the proposed success criteria work for us. I’ve looped in Legal and Raj to confirm owners.

Lydia

--
Lydia Gomez
Head of Product Operations | Novaterra Systems
lydia@novaterra.com | (212) 555-0122

Attachment referenced: Novaterra_security_request.docx (requested items list)
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Gomez <lydia@novaterra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & MAP: Novaterra pilot milestones and responsibilities

Appreciate the clarity, Lydia — and thanks for looping Legal and Raj. I updated the MAP to reflect the timeline shifts and added a short artifacts checklist for procurement (SOC 2 summary + data retention + PCI scoping). New file attached: Novaterra_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (updated).

Key changes made in this update:
- Integration kickoff -> 2027-02-28 (owner: Raj Patel)
- Legal/SOW signoff -> 2027-03-09 (owner: Novaterra Legal)
- Performance validation -> 2027-03-12 (owner: Redwood SE)
- Go-live target (pilot completion) -> 2027-03-24; exec signature window 2027-03-22 to 2027-03-24

Ben, Sean — tagging you for visibility on the signature readiness and whether we should prepare a procurement packet (SOW + brief exec summary + quick pricing appendix). If Legal confirms the review window, we’ll move the SOW to redlined doc and jump into procurement outreach.

Lydia — once you confirm the owners and that the artifacts checklist is sufficient, I’ll ask our Contracts lead to create a procurement-ready SOW and send a DocuSign link for signature preparedness.

Thanks,
Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Owners confirmed on our side: Raj (integration), Novaterra Legal (SOW review), Lydia (exec sign-off). The artifacts checklist looks complete for Legal’s initial review; they’ll reach out if they need a specific appendix.

We’ve instructed procurement to prepare a PO once the SOW is in final form. I’m fine with the pilot go-live window of 2027-03-24 — we expect to sign the SOW by 2027-03-10 if the redlines are minor.

For visibility, I’ve uploaded a provisional PO (PO_Novaterra_20270220.pdf) to our shared drive and will route for internal approval once Redwood shares the SOW.

Looking forward to the kickoff.
